task_completion.description: Agent navigates to Wikipedia, GitHub, and Reddit in Microsoft Edge.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the Edge browser address bar with en.wikipedia.org, github.com, and reddit.com loaded.

task_completion.description: Agent opens DevTools and inspects the Application/Storage tab for the target sites.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the Edge DevTools panel open, specifically the 'Application' tab with 'Cookies', 'Local Storage', 'Session Storage', or 'IndexedDB' selected.

task_completion.description: Agent views specific storage keys or cookie names for each site.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing lists of cookie names (e.g., 'WMF-Last-Access') or local storage keys in the DevTools data grid for the three domains.

task_completion.description: Agent creates the report file at the specified path on the Desktop.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor (like Gedit or VS Code) or a terminal 'cat' command showing the file /home/ga/Desktop/storage_audit_report.txt exists.

task_completion.description: The report contains specific names of keys/cookies and counts for all four storage categories for each site.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The content of storage_audit_report.txt visible in a screenshot, containing sections for Wikipedia, GitHub, and Reddit with counts for Cookies, Local Storage, Session Storage, and IndexedDB.

task_completion.description: The report includes a summary identifying which site stores the most data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The end of the report file contains a concluding sentence or section comparing the data volumes and naming the site with the highest count.

integrity.description: Agent interacted with the browser GUI rather than just simulating file creation.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the browser window and DevTools active; the report should not appear instantly without the agent visiting the sites.

integrity.description: The report contains actual keys found during the session, not generic placeholders.
integrity.visual_evidence: The report text should list real keys like 'user_session' (GitHub) or 'session_id' rather than 'key1, key2'.

integrity.description: The agent used the exact file path specified in the instructions.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file manager or terminal shows the file specifically at /home/ga/Desktop/storage_audit_report.txt.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must audit Wikipedia, GitHub, and Reddit. The report must be saved to /home/ga/Desktop/storage_audit_report.txt. Required storage categories to audit: Cookies, Local Storage, Session Storage, and IndexedDB. The report must include specific key names, approximate counts for each category per site, and a final summary identifying the site with the most data.
